adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, in embed_controller.rb line 14-15, when topic_id is nil, it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` to enqueue a background job, then renders 'loading'. However, the test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43-47 sets up expectations directly on TopicRetriever (`TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)`), but the controller doesn't call TopicRetriever directly - it enqueues a job. The job (in app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) is what calls TopicRetriever. So the test's expectations on TopicRetriever will never be satisfied by the controller action, making this a real test bug where the test doesn't properly verify the loading path behavior.
